risks.risk: Engine may not be functional or may have internal damage (e.g., seized, worn components, oil leaks).
risks.proof: A video showing the engine running, or a close-up of the oil pan and cylinder head for signs of leaks or damage.

risks.risk: Gearbox may be damaged or not compatible with the engine.
risks.proof: A video showing the gearbox being tested or a close-up of the gearbox housing and input shaft.

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the engine's serial number and any damage markings.
